statement: Degree-2 hash functions. Assuming the conjectured intractability of solving a random system of quadratic equations over Z2 , a uniformly random degree-2 mapping is a universal one-way hash function (UOWHF). UOWHF relaxes CRH by forcing the attacker to find a collision with a random input picked by a challenger. On the other hand, a uniformly random degree-2 mapping is not a CRH. We leave the existence of degree-2 CRH open, and relate it to open questions on the existence of degree-2 randomized encodings of functions.
